item.title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo

turns.text: Can you turn this into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please.

item.tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

answer_sheet.Clothing and background: Navy blazer and plain light grey background.
answer_sheet.Lighting and expression: Natural, approachable and professional; keep my smile.

must_haves: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.

turns.text: Can you turn this pic into a headshot for me? I’ve been meaning to update my profile picture for a while and keep putting it off. It’s for LinkedIn, and I’d like it to be square. Please give me a navy blazer and a plain light grey background. I always end up overthinking profile pictures, so I thought I’d finally ask for help.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the headshot because your connected Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

Once credits are available, I can use your photo to make the square LinkedIn headshot with a navy blazer and plain light grey background, while preserving your natural features.

style.prompt: Edit the supplied portrait into a polished, natural professional LinkedIn headshot. Preserve the woman's identity, facial features, skin tone, natural expression and dark curly hair. Dress her in a well-tailored navy blazer over a simple neutral top. Replace the park entirely with a plain light grey studio background. Use soft flattering studio lighting and a centered head-and-shoulders square composition with comfortable space above her hair. Keep realistic skin texture and a believable photographic appearance; no excessive retouching. No text or logos.
